author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities – Product Manager

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business goals.
* Gather requirements and convert them into clear product specifications.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, and QA teams for product development.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, and task prioritization.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback, and key metrics.
* Ensure timely delivery of features with quality standards.
* Identify opportunities for product improvement and innovation.
* Communicate project updates and progress to stakeholders.

Pay: ₹42,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Responsibilities**

o Comprehensive experience (12+ yrs) in Banking & Financial services with exposure in Payments products implementations, Core banking system Implementation (large Programs) in the space of Transaction Banking business

o Experience as business analyst/product ownership/project management liaising with business and IT teams

o Hand-on experience of Payments or Cash Management products is the key (Must Have)

o Should be able to work closely with business experts and help them to understand the requirement and translate it to BRD in terms of benefits to be realized. (Must Have)

o To work with BE/PO and prioritize requirements to vendor/IT and validate the solution provided.

o Participate in change management which can include task as validating the training material, end user training plan and scope, e.t.c

o Support the program management with the impacts assessment for change requests.

o Steer necessary governances like OPCO, Steerco with C-Level executives and stakeholders

o Experience with Pyramid, Budgeting and financial planning

o Leadership experience in terms of managing and leading a team and their structural activities as HR manager

o Must Have experience on payment file format ISO20022, SEPA Products (SCT, SDD, Instant SCT) and SWIFT (Cross Border Payments)

o Knowledge market standard Payment Engines like FIS Clear2Pay, BANCS, TEMINOS T24, FlexCube, Intellect Design FCH, Global PayPlus is an added advantage

o Advanced skills and experience in large program/project management

o Should have worked in multi-dimensional teams across Asia and Europe geographies

o Should be flexible to work on any Shift timings

* **Profile Required**
  + Knowledge on end-to-end commercial banking processes with specific focus on payments and cash Management
  + Functional expert, with strong knowledge of end-end payments process
  + The person must become the point of contact for the all business requirements on payments transformation projects
  + The person must be able to steer large roadmap topics in as project manager
  + The person must have knowledge of the payment instruments and processes.

  + Communicate and negotiate on deliverables, scope, delays and priorities.
  + Ability to create a relationship of trust and faith with the clients

--------------------

At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious. Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating, and taking action are part of our DNA. If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!

You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. title: Staff Product Manager – Agentic Application Security Testing
job_description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**About the Role**
------------------

Harness is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the future of Agentic Application Security. You will lead our Code Security and AI Security Agents portfolio, spanning static application security testing (SAST), AI-powered vulnerability triage, and autonomous remediation.

As AI coding agents transform how software is built, security must evolve beyond detecting vulnerabilities to autonomously investigating, validating, and fixing them at machine speed.

We are looking for a product leader who can help build autonomous security engineering systems that understand code, reason about security risks, generate secure fixes, and continuously validate outcomes across modern development environments.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **AI-Native Code Security:** Own the strategy and roadmap for SAST, code analysis, reachability, exploitability, and AI-powered vulnerability discovery.
* **Autonomous Security Agents:** Build intelligent triage and remediation agents that investigate findings, assess risk, generate fixes, and verify security outcomes.
* **Agentic Remediation Workflows:** Drive autonomous repository analysis, multi-file code changes, dependency upgrades, test generation, regression validation, and pull request creation.
* **Agentic Developer Ecosystem:** Integrate security into AI coding assistants, autonomous development agents, IDEs, SCM, and CI/CD workflows.
* **Next-Generation Security Testing:** Explore LLM-driven security analysis, sandbox execution, exploit validation, and continuous security testing.
* **Product Strategy & Execution:** Own product differentiation, customer engagement, roadmap execution, adoption, and business outcomes while partnering with engineering, security research, and go-to-market teams.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of product management experience in Application Security, AI Developer Tools, DevSecOps, or software engineering platforms.
* Strong understanding of application security, SAST, vulnerability management, secure coding, and developer workflows.
* Experience or strong technical familiarity with AI coding agents, LLM orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous software development.
* Understanding of how agents reason over repositories, plan and execute tasks, modify code, run tests, and iteratively resolve failures.
* Ability to translate advances in AI and software engineering into reliable, enterprise-grade products.
* Proven experience driving product strategy, technical execution, customer adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to collaborate with engineering, security research, and executive stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience building autonomous coding agents, AI-native developer tools, or application security products.
* Knowledge of code property graphs, dataflow analysis, reachability, exploitability, and software composition analysis.
* Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, MCP, sandbox environments, agent memory, and feedback-driven execution.
* Experience with automated vulnerability remediation, secure code generation, and verification workflows.
* Background in software engineering, security engineering, or AI/ML.

**Why Join Harness?**
---------------------

Help define the next generation of application security, where intelligent agents don't just identify vulnerabilities but autonomously investigate, remediate, and verify them.

At Harness, you'll work at the intersection of AI, application security, and software engineering to build security products designed for a world where humans and AI agents develop software together.

  

**What You Will Have at Harness**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
* Quarterly Harness TGIF-Off / 4 days
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
* Recharge & Reset Program
* Monthly internet reimbursement
* Commuter benefits

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we connect tens of millions of buyers and sellers globally, processing billions of dollars in trade. Our platform powers trusted commerce at global scale, and we continue to invest in the products and platforms that make those experiences simpler, smarter, and more reliable.

The Billing Platform sits at the intersection of commerce, payments, and financial systems. It powers critical capabilities across billing, invoicing, financial transaction processing, and revenue-related workflows, enabling scalable and reliable financial operations across eBay.

We are seeking an ambitious, impact-driven Product Manager to lead critical capabilities for this platform. If you thrive on solving complex, large-scale platform challenges and translating intricacy into seamless user experiences, this is your opportunity to build at immense scale.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

As a Product Manager on the Payments Platform team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of core billing initiatives. You will partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, finance, tax, and operations to architect modern, scalable platform capabilities that elevate trust, efficiency, and reliability for millions of users.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Define & Drive Strategy:** Partner with payments, finance, operations, and business units to discover high-value platform opportunities and translate them into a clear product vision.
* **Architect Scalable Solutions:** Collaborate closely with engineering to build reusable, API-based charging, invoicing, and transaction workflows that support diverse global use cases.
* **Lead Execution:** Write clear, high-quality product requirements and user stories, set measurable success metrics, and manage end-to-end rollouts across complex multi-system dependencies.
* **Prioritize for Impact:** Balance trade-offs between innovation, platform resilience, risk mitigation, and execution speed to maximize partner and customer value.
* **Optimize with Data:** Leverage operational metrics, analytical insights, and partner feedback to continuously evaluate product performance and guide rapid iteration.
* **Champion Quality & Trust:** Proactively identify risks, resolve complex cross-functional alignment blockers, and continuously elevate product quality and platform experience.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Platform Product Experience:** 3+ years in product management, with a proven track record of shipping technical, platform-based products.
* **FinTech / Payments Foundation:** Practical experience in payments, billing, invoicing, or related financial transaction processing environments.
* **Technical Execution:** Strong ability to translate business capabilities into technical requirements and partner effectively with engineering teams on architectural choices.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Skilled in using data to quantify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure product performance metrics.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of driving consensus across matrixed teams.

### **Bonus**

* Hands-on experience with API-based architectures, eCommerce platforms, or large-scale multi-sided marketplaces.
* Familiarity with financial reporting, ERPs, revenue recognition, tax integrations, or controllership domain workflows.
* Exposure to compliance, audits, or billing-adjacent platform domains.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

Gurgaon

**About the position:**

Manage the commercial performance of the business from the point of view of revenue, market share and profitability. With additional inputs for strategic and Tactical planning, Project management, Product Life cycle management, Business Analytics, Budgeting and forecasting experience.

**Primary Job Functions:**

  

* Developing and implementing marketing plans for the country according to overall Urology plan and budget.
* Portfolio Strategy & business development planning
* Leading Product Launch and Life Cycle Management in collaboration with sales leadership, local and APAC/global cross-functional stakeholders.
* Analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption etc. and implement Campaigns to drive Portfolio as per division’s goals.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate and further the achievements of business goals.

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Strategically managing all aspects of internal and external marketing strategy
* Conceptualize and Lead execution of marketing plans for Urology as per Business goals and budgets, coordinate with internal functions, customers and external service providers, monitor on ground execution of programs/ conferences/ events/ promotions etc the right set of metrics are in place for tracking success.
* Planning and implementing Product launches and Product life cycle management.
* Monitoring sales performance and effectiveness of marketing programs against goals set.
* Product Life cycle management and working with cross functional teams to drive product approvals, inventory planning and product availability as per portfolio marketing plans.
* Conduct analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption
* Development of key marketing communications for portfolio, works closely with agencies and media to develop right messaging and its delivery, tracking the effectiveness of the communication to drive differentiation.
* Establish relationships with KOLs in the field, Drive KOL and customer engagement
* Conduct investigative research to assess brand image, market share and growth opportunities.

**Must Have:**

  

* MBA in marketing
* 5+ Years of exp is required in Medical devices and marketing. Experience of working in marketing / product management function.
* Candidate should have handled some product launches independently
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and presentation skills and the ability to manage multiple programs at once and effectively prioritize work are essential.
* Candidate should have experience in Product marketing & Digital marketing
* Proficiency in excel, power point and Microsoft tool
* Candidate with Sales experience or experience in Urology will be a preference but not a limitation
* Experience of working, interacting with KOLs / physicians.
* Experience of working with cross functional teams – finance, sales, regulatory, legal in a corporate environment
* Travel requirement approx. 7-10 days a month.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, initiatives, and user stories are clearly defined, refined, and prioritized.

* Define product roadmaps and priorities aligned with HNW (High Net Worth) business objectives and technology strategy.

* Collaborate with Business, Product, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

title: Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting
job_description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new organization. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting**

**What you will do:**

Are you excited by the intersection of financial planning, real estate, technology expense, and category governance? Join PFI Innovation Centre India as a Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting. You will lead end-to-end planning, forecasting, reporting, and governance for the Non-Labor Technology, Properties, and Other expense categories, applying sound accounting judgment and partnering with Newark stakeholders to resolve complex category issues. The role is based in India and reports to the Director, Expense Management; the employee work arrangement will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Lead knowledge transfer, dual-run, and stabilization of the expense processes transitioning to PFI Innovation Centre India, stabilizing, and continuously improving.
* Own the forecasting model and reporting tools for the expense category, building quarterly forecasts and delivering quarterly management reporting, overseeing forecast quality, planning assumptions, financial controls, and variance analysis.
* Provide real estate and lease-accounting judgment to support accurate planning and financial reporting.
* Analyze category performance, key variances, and risks, translating findings into management insights.
* Partner with Newark Expense Management and respective product teams to clearly document requirements and ensure accurate, timely and complete financials.
* Serve as data domain owner for Non-Labor Technology and Properties and Other expense data, ensuring data quality, consistent definitions, and governance.
* Drive reporting standardization, stronger governance, and continuous improvement across non-labor expense processes.
* Gather end-user feedback to prioritize and implement enhancements to expense planning and reporting.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Experience in properties, facilities, occupancy, and Non-Labor Technology expense management, including planning and forecasting.
* Strong financial reporting, expense analytics, and variance-analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of financial controls, governance, and data-quality practices.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management, complex issue-resolution, and process-improvement skills.
* Ability to apply accounting judgment to complex real estate and lease matters.
* Experience with capitalization of fixed assets and technology, including the related accounting and reporting.
* Lease, real estate, fixed assets, and technology accounting experience under US GAAP and US STAT.
* Experience working across global and matrixed finance teams.

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience transitioning finance processes into a GCC, shared services, or global delivery environment and stabilizing them to steady state.
* Experience leading, coaching, and talent development.

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

  

**Skills:** Financial Reporting , Expense Management , Data Governance

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Avam is an applied and materials sciences company developing biology, chemistry, and materials science products for testing, research, manufacturing, and cleaner energy applications. Working at the intersection of science and product development, the team focuses on bringing technically rigorous products to market that support customers across a range of scientific and industrial use cases.

This Product Manager role will help shape how Avam’s scientific product portfolio evolves to meet customer needs and market opportunities. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to guide product direction, align priorities, and support decisions that balance scientific depth with business impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmap for Avam’s scientific product portfolio.
* Set priorities for Avam’s products and customer experiences, aligning the work with the organization’s mission and goals.
* Gather input from visitors, staff, and other stakeholders to understand needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop clear product plans, goals, and timelines, and keep work moving from idea through launch.
* Coordinate with teams across the organization to plan, deliver, and improve products, programs, or services.
* Define how success will be measured and track results such as customer feedback, participation, revenue, or other agreed-upon goals.
* Use research and performance data to recommend changes and guide future product decisions.
* Manage product budgets, schedules, and competing requests; raise risks or resource needs early.
* Keep stakeholders informed about priorities, progress, decisions, and results.
* Ensure products and experiences are accessible, consistent with Avam’s values, and useful to the people they serve.
* Document product decisions, processes, and lessons learned to support ongoing improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher.
* 4+ years of product management experience in biotechnology or life sciences.
* Experience managing scientific products from discovery through commercial launch.
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into actionable product requirements.
* Experience with scientific product areas or technical environments such as biotech research tools, diagnostics, lab instrumentation, manufacturing workflows, and cleaner-energy materials applications.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across research, engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection for remote work.

**Job description**

**We're hiring**

**Product Manager E-commerce, CRO & AI Products**

Own the customer journey for CrazyNeon, a fast-growing custom signage brand serving customers across the US and beyond. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data, and applied AI — not a typical roadmap-and-tickets PM job.

Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.Gurgaon **On-siteProduct & Growth4–8 yearsFull-time**

**About CrazyNeon**

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

*The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.*

**What you'll do**

**1. E-commerce product management**

* Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
* Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
* Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
* Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
* Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

**2. Conversion rate optimization**

CRO is a major part of this role.

* Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
* Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
* Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
* Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
* Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

**3. Data & analytics**

* Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
* Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
* Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
* Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
* Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

**4. Customer research**

* Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
* Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
* Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
* Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
* Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

**5. AI & new-age products**

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

* AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
* AI artwork analysis and preflight
* AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
* AI-assisted quoting and configuration
* AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
* AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
* AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
* Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

*You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.*

**6. Product strategy & roadmap**

* Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
* Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
* Set KPIs for every major initiative.

**7. Experimentation & innovation**

We want someone who's constantly asking: *"What can we do differently?"*

* Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
* Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
* Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
* Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-have**

* 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar.
* Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels.
* Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.
* Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools.
* Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions.
* Experience working closely with developers and designers.
* Solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered products.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation.
* Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools.
* Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce.

**Who thrives in this role**

**Data-driven** — you look at the numbers before making product calls.

**Customer-obsessed** — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do.

**Commercially minded** — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value.

**Experimentation-oriented** — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks.

**Technically curious** — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology.

**AI-curious** — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype.

**Entrepreneurial** — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap.

**Hands-on** — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish.

**How we'll measure success**

Website conversion rate

Revenue per visitor

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

Lead-to-order conversion

Average order value

Revenue from new product experiences

Adoption of new digital/AI products

Customer engagement

Number & quality of experiments run

Reduction in customer friction / manual work

**Why join CrazyNeon?**

This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience.

You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit.

**Department:** Product Management **Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent

title: Senior Product Manager – Agent Platform & Enterprise Configuration
job_description:
### **Role description**

Experience: 6–10 years overall, including 4+ years in Product Management

**Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own product capabilities across RippleHire’s AI Agent platform, enterprise configuration and customer readiness.

This is a hands-on product role. You will own features end-to-end—from customer problems and product definition through engineering, launch and adoption—while ensuring that what we build can be easily configured, deployed and reused across enterprise customers.

A key part of the role is turning customer-specific requirements into scalable product capabilities rather than repeated custom engineering.

**Responsibilities**

* Own product features from problem discovery and requirements through development, launch and adoption.
* Work with customers and internal teams to understand product and configuration requirements.
* Define user journeys, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering, UX and QA to deliver high-quality features.
* Identify where customer-specific requirements can become reusable configuration or platform capabilities.
* Ensure new features are practical and ready for customers to use.
* Use customer and implementation feedback to continuously improve the product.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience in Product Management for B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Working knowledge of AI / Generative AI / AI AgentsProven experience delivering product features end-to-end.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering teams.
* Experience with configurable products, workflows, platforms, APIs or integrations.
* Strong problem-solving and product judgment.
* Experience in HRTech / ATS is a plus
* Good communication skills and ability to work with customers and cross-functional teams.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
As a Product Manager you will closely work with Product Owner to manage execution of end

to end Product management life cycle starting from roadmap to marketing activities.

* Oversee strategic program roadmap, development, launch, and marketing to gain maximum

benefit from each product

* Oversee day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client

experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate,

and remove obstacles to achieve business results

* Create low-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, documentation to make your case stronger
* Execute client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel

strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to VCPL

Clients

* Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, multiple countries, region, or

business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into

strategic decisions affecting job family or function within a region or business

* Manage client and competitor market research, contribute in production innovation roadmap,

continuously improving and modernizing the presentation of the products in the market,

create relevant documentation managing the product life cycle.

* Contribute to achievement of acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue

performance, and expense management goals.

* Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and

implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management.

* Reports project status, scope changes and critical metrics to all stakeholders including core

team and senior management

* Serve as a liaison with other teams to ensure timely completion of project tasks.
* Define milestones with Product Owner and Scrum Master and coordinate with various internal

and external stakeholders to launch products as per defined timelines.

* Preempt potential delays, and de-bottleneck issues quickly in order to avoid slippage
* Run tight project management to meet launch timelines.

Qualifications:

* MBA and engineering degree preferred
* Sound experience in market research and product management life cycle along with detail to

the documentation.

* Familiar with Agile methodologies
* Functional experience in marketing, credit, acquisitions, product development, or analytics
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations

or requirements

* Ability to work unsupervised and adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Demonstrated analytical skills
* Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

author: Hiring Manager
title: Teradata CX Apps Product Manager
job_description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As Product Manager for **CX Apps**, you will own the strategy and execution for Teradata's real-time decisioning and campaign management capabilities, leading the transition of VCX and CIM from standalone enterprise applications into the decisioning and execution layer of a unified agentic CX platform. You will work directly with engineering, field, architecture, and customers to close the adoption and reference gap against competition, and deliver agentic experiences that prove the platform's value at scale.

You Will:

* **Lead product strategy and roadmap for VCX and CIM**, driving their evolution from legacy standalone apps into the Campaign Strategy and Real-Time Decisioning agents at the core of Teradata's agentic CX platform.
* **Define agent architectures built on MCP and Vantage**, with explicit go/no-go gates tied to conversion lift, setup time reduction, and real-time adoption growth across enterprise accounts.
* **Own competitive positioning**, building the proof point program, arming field and COE teams.
* **Act as the connective tissue between engineering, field, and architecture**, translating customer requirements into prioritized roadmap decisions while holding the integration contract with the data foundation layer.
* **Present product vision and investment asks to senior leadership**, framing architectural tradeoffs, adoption risks, and platform sequencing in materials that inform decisions, not just report status.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* **5+ years of product management experience** with enterprise SaaS, CX, or decisioning platforms.
* **Hands-on experience** with or strong understanding of real-time decisioning, campaign management, or customer engagement platforms (e.g., Pega CDH, Hightouch, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe).• **Familiarity with agentic AI architectures**, MCP-based tooling, and orchestration frameworks.
* **Demonstrated ability to engage technical customers**, field teams, and architects to drive adoption and build references.
* **Strong executive communication skills**, able to frame strategy, tradeoffs, and investment asks in crisp written and verbal form.

**What You'll Bring**

* **A clear point of view** on how agentic AI reshapes enterprise CX, from episodic campaign management to always-on, decision-centric customer engagement.
* **Comfort operating across** legacy sustaining, active engineering transition, and field enablement simultaneously.
* **Proven ability to translate customer pain** into prioritized roadmap decisions and ship with urgency.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description: Short Description for Internal Candidates**

We are looking for a technically strong Manager – AI Product Experience to own the design and delivery of AI-powered product features for the Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash domain. The role combines hands-on AI engineering capability with product management ownership, requiring the incumbent to work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and Finance stakeholders to ship intelligent AR automation that reduces DSO, improves cash application accuracy, and enhances collections intelligence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Design & AI Strategy**

* Define and manage the AI product roadmap for AR capabilities: cash application automation, deductions management, credit risk scoring, collections prioritization, and dispute resolution.
* Translate AR business requirements into AI architectures, orchestration frameworks, and product features that deliver measurable outcomes (DSO reduction, auto-match rate improvement).
* Design Generative AI solutions using state-of-the-art models (GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3) for AR-specific tasks: automated remittance parsing, dispute email generation, and intelligent customer communication.
* Architect Agentic AI workflows for autonomous AR operations: cash matching agents, dispute classification agents, and collections prioritization agents using LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

**Technical Leadership**

* Guide data science and ML engineering teams in building, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs and ML models for AR use cases: payment prediction, credit risk scoring, and anomaly detection.
* Architect scalable AI pipelines on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); drive adoption of LLM orchestration stacks and MLOps practices for production AR AI systems.
* Stay current on advancements in Generative AI, NLP, and ML engineering frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph); proactively incorporate innovations into the AR AI product.
* Ensure AI solutions meet compliance, security, and auditability standards applicable to receivables and financial data.

**Client Engagement**

* Collaborate with client Finance technology teams and AR operations leads to identify AI-driven automation opportunities and co-define solution requirements.
* Present Generative AI use cases, proof-of-concept demos, and ROI narratives to both technical and non-technical client audiences.
* Act as a trusted product and AI advisor to clients on the technical, ethical, and operational considerations of deploying AR AI solutions.
* Support Sr. AVP in first-engagement solutioning, client workshops, and RFP/RFI responses for AR transformation engagements.

**Product Management & Delivery**

* Write detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-powered AR features; manage and prioritize the product backlog.
* Conduct user discovery interviews with AR operations teams, controllers, and treasury leads to surface pain points and validate product hypotheses.
* Lead sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives with cross-functional Agile engineering teams; manage release readiness across QA, UX, and compliance workstreams.
* Define and track product metrics: cash application hit rate, auto-match accuracy, DSO improvement, collector productivity, and AI model performance.
Author product collateral: demo scripts, solution one-pagers, sales enablement decks, and ROI calculators for AR AI solutions.  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience (9–12 Years)**

* B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 9–12 years of total experience, with at least 4–5 years in AI/ML product engineering and 3+ years of Finance technology experience with strong AR/O2C domain exposure.
* 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models: prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and building applications using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAGAS.
* Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and applying ML models to finance classification, prediction, and anomaly detection use cases.
* Working experience with Agentic AI concepts: Autonomous Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph; ability to design and deploy multi-step AI agent workflows for AR automation.
* Experience in ML Engineering and MLOps: model deployment, performance monitoring, versioning, and retraining pipelines (MLflow, SageMaker, Azure ML).
* Strong software engineering skills in Python; experience building AI-powered APIs, integrations, and cloud-native microservices.
* Proven track record of delivering AI product features from ideation through production deployment in an Agile environment; CSPO or equivalent certification preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Solid functional knowledge of Accounts Receivable: cash application, collections, credit management, deductions, billing, and ERP AR modules (SAP FSCM, Oracle Fusion AR, HighRadius, Esker).
* Experience with NLP techniques for remittance advice parsing, dispute letter classification, and payment confirmation extraction from unstructured documents.
* Understanding of Vector Databases and Graph Databases and their application in AR knowledge retrieval, semantic matching, and customer intelligence.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) for both model inferencing and fine-tuning AR-specific models.
* Strong SQL and Python proficiency; experience with BI/analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI) for data-driven product and model performance decisions.
* Excellent communication skills: ability to explain Generative AI concepts and product value to non-technical Finance audiences.
* Experience working cross-functionally across engineering, data science, UX, and Finance SME teams; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced product environment.
* Participation in RFI/RFP, thought leadership, and client-facing solutioning activities preferred.

* Design Generative AI solutions using state-of-the-art models (GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3) for AR-specific tasks: automated remittance parsing, dispute email generation, and intelligent customer communication.
* Architect Agentic AI workflows for autonomous AR operations: cash matching agents, dispute classification agents, and collections prioritization agents using LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

**Technical Leadership**

* Guide data science and ML engineering teams in building, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs and ML models for AR use cases: payment prediction, credit risk scoring, and anomaly detection.
* Architect scalable AI pipelines on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); drive adoption of LLM orchestration stacks and MLOps practices for production AR AI systems.
* Stay current on advancements in Generative AI, NLP, and ML engineering frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph); proactively incorporate innovations into the AR AI product.
* Ensure AI solutions meet compliance, security, and auditability standards applicable to receivables and financial data.

job_description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**So, what’s the role all about?**

This role offers the opportunity to shape products that combat financial crime while ensuring adherence to complex regulatory requirements and working as a Product Owner in a matrix structure. The ideal candidate will combine domain expertise, strategic thinking, technical acumen, and a practical understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts to deliver impactful solutions.

**How will you make an impact?**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap Development**

* Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for FCC solutions.
* Align product initiatives with organizational goals and client needs, focusing on innovation and compliance.

* **Regulatory and Industry Expertise**

* Stay updated on global financial crime regulations and ensure product offerings meet compliance requirements.
* Analyse emerging trends in financial crime to identify opportunities for product enhancement.

* **Solution Design & Development**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including domain experts, engineers, data scientists, and AI specialists, to design solutions for the Financial Crime and Compliance platform, including AI-assisted and Agentic AI-enabled workflows where relevant.

* **AI & Agentic Innovation**

* Identify practical opportunities to apply Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts, such as AI agents, workflow automation, decision support, and assisted investigations, to improve product outcomes and user productivity.
* Translate AI/Agentic AI concepts into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable business value while partnering with engineering and data science teams.
* Demonstrate conceptual understanding and some hands-on exposure with LLM-based solutions, prompt-driven workflows, RAG patterns, AI agents, or enterprise AI tools.
* Support responsible AI practices by considering governance, explainability, security, privacy, model limitations, and compliance expectations in product design.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with clients, business stakeholders, and internal teams to gather insights and translate them into actionable product requirements.
* Act as the voice of the customer and ensure the delivery of solutions that exceed expectations.

* **Agile Product Management**

* Own the product backlog, prioritize features, and define user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Scrum teams to deliver high-quality, timely product releases.

* **Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Leverage data and analytics to assess product performance, measure ROI, and identify areas for improvement.
* Recommend enhancements based on insights from client feedback and market analysis.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* **Experience:**
* + **5-8 years** of product management experience, preferably in Financial Crime, Compliance, or Financial Services domains. Experience contributing to AI-enabled products, intelligent automation initiatives, GenAI solutions, or Agentic AI use cases is highly desirable.
* **Domain Expertise:**
* + Strong knowledge of financial crime regulations, compliance requirements, and risk management practices.
* **Analytical & Problem-Solving:**
* + Strong problem-solving skills and ability to synthesize complex requirements into actionable product strategies.
  + Proficiency in data analysis and metrics-driven decision-making.
* **Technical Skills:**
* + Experience working with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira/Confluence.
  + Understanding of APIs, data modelling, and scalable system design.
  + Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and agent orchestration concepts.
  + Conceptual understanding of Agentic AI patterns, including task planning, tool usage, human-in-the-loop review, and workflow automation.
  + Some hands-on exposure to AI tools or prototypes, such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted workflows, RAG experiments, low-code AI agents, or collaboration with engineering teams on proof-of-concepts.
  + Ability to convert AI capabilities into product requirements, customer value propositions, adoption metrics, and responsible implementation considerations.
* **Communication:**
* + Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate vision, plans, and progress clearly.
  + Ability to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**What’s in it for you?**

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

**Requisition ID: 11569**  
**Reporting into:** Manager, Product Management, Actimize

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

***About NiCE***

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*

*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, (Workplace & Real Estate Facilities)WREF, CGA (Communications & Government Affairs) and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation is responsible for the delivery, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of GSK's IP21, A1PE, Historian, reporting, and visualization platforms. The role translates manufacturing, engineering, and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable manufacturing data management. Working with manufacturing sites, (Manufacturing Execution System) MES teams, Engineers, Architects, Quality/Validation, Service teams, and external partners, the Product Engineer designs, configures, integrates, tests, validates, and supports historian and visualization solutions aligned with global standards and product roadmaps. The role manages technical backlogs, supports requirements analysis, coordinates system integrations and data flows, and ensures data integrity, cybersecurity, performance, and platform reliability across the manufacturing technology landscape. Leverage AI-assisted tools to configure, test, and document IP21/A1PE solutions, ensuring all AI-generated outputs are validated for accuracy, data integrity, security, and (Good Practice) GxP compliance prior to release. Deliver reliable historian and visualization solutions that support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the design of IP21/A1PE solutions and integrations within the approved architecture, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, making and documenting design decisions, and ensuring alignment with architectural, operational, security, and compliance standards.
* Maintain IP21/A1PE engineering standards and reusable configuration patterns and provide technical guidance and lead engineers to ensure consistent, scalable, and supportable solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate manufacturing, engineering and data requirements into IP21 solutions and improvements, and manage and prioritize the IP21 backlog based on business value, risk, compliance and operational needs.
* Deliver historian capabilities by collaborating with Engineers, Architects, MES teams and vendors.
* Monitor system performance, data quality and user adoption, driving continuous improvement.
* Ensure operational readiness through documentation, training, support and validation activities, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data integrity, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Define, test, validate and release IP21 changes, ensuring traceability and compliance, and manage integration and dependencies between IP21, MES, A1PE and other manufacturing systems.
* Support issue resolution, system maintenance and ongoing platform optimization.
* Coordinate supplier activities and leverage data and AI-enabled tools to improve delivery, support and business value
* Use AI-assisted tools as the default way of configuring, scripting, testing and documenting IP21/A1PE changes, and validate all AI-generated output for accuracy, data integrity, security and GxP before release.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in making technical and product configuration decisions that impact data integrity, operational visibility and business performance, including managing priorities, collaborating with cross-functional teams and delivering historian and visualization solutions that meet reliability, security, compliance and user requirements.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in industrial data historian systems (for example, Aspen IP21, A1PE, OSI PI Historian or similar platforms), data visualization platforms and manufacturing reporting solutions within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or other regulated environments.
* Experience in developing and supporting real-time dashboards, reports, trends and analytics solutions that enable operational monitoring and decision-making.
* Experience in working with process, production, quality and equipment data from MES, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), automation, historian and enterprise systems.
* Experience in data analysis, data modelling, data integration and data management for operational and business reporting.
* Experience in configuring and supporting historian and visualization applications, including performance optimisation and troubleshooting.
* Experience in integrating historian and visualization platforms with MES, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), laboratory and other enterprise systems, including use of industrial connectivity technologies and protocols such as OPC UA (Unified Architecture), OPC HDA (Historical Data Access) or similar standards.
* Experience in SQL (Structured Query Language), databases, reporting tools and data analytics technologies.
* Experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting, dashboard and visualization solutions.
* Experience in working in Agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers and support teams.
* Experience in supporting system validation, data integrity, compliance and change management processes in GxP-compliant or other regulated environments.
* Experience in analysing operational data to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimisation.
* Experience in using AI-enabled tools for data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting and decision support, including validating AI-generated outputs, understanding AI limitations and maintaining accountability for data quality, security, GxP compliance and product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in written and verbal communication, including explaining product decisions and technology constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Experience in organising work, maintaining traceability and applying consistent documentation practices.
* Experience in working across global, cross-functional and supplier teams in a collaborative way.
* Experience in designing and delivering user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.
