job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for a DPTF platform product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.

The Product Owner leads a group of related Products, CSM for Finance and Procurement, Legal Service Delivery within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved.

**Key Responsibilities**

Describe the key deliverables to be achieved by the post holder and the ongoing responsibilities of the role

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the ServiceNow Business, Risk & Security Product Manager and the Senior Director of ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context with experience.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

Agile Delivery, Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Executive Communications, Leadership Strategies, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD), Software Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

text:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering segmentation capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering segmentation improvements that increased policy coverage, reduced risk or enabled secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

Automation Technology, Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Based Services, Cloud Networking, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Firewalls, IP Address Management (IPAM), IT Network Security, Load Balancers, Microsegmentation, Network Design, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT), Operational Technology (OT) Network Segmentation Architecture, Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Overview**

We are looking for a **Group Product Manager** Leader passionate about building customer-centric products and experiences. In this role, you will help define product vision and strategy, collaborate closely with engineering and design teams, engage directly with customers, and deliver productivity solutions in a flagship app in the M365 suite. Our teams are building the next generation of AI capabilities in the M365 suite for millions of users worldwide to improve how people communicate, organize information, and get work done, all while working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Own the overall health, quality, strategy, roadmap, delivery and the outcomes customers experience for a product line and its features in the M365 suite. Set direction and priorities for your area, make the hard trade-offs, and hold the line on scope, sequencing and quality. Ensure consistent delivery excellence through Microsoft methodologies, quality standards and governance.
* Partner closely with engineering, design, research, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative customer-facing solutions.
* Engage customers and partners to understand needs, validate scenarios, gather feedback, and inform product decisions.
* Translate customer, market, and business opportunities into clear product requirements and execution plans.
* Excel in storytelling, build the business case for investment, size the opportunity, define the success metrics, and defend the plan in leadership, planning and review forums.
* Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
* Prioritize investments and features based on customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, and strategic goals.
* Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and communicate results and impact to leadership.
* Support go-to-market efforts by partnering with marketing, sales, and business teams to drive adoption and customer success.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop product managers through coaching, clear expectations and accountability. Model Microsoft's Model, Coach, Care leadership culture — creating an environment where people grow and perform at their best. Partner with capacity and resource teams to align the right skills to the right work at the right time. Own the professional development of the people in your area, including onboarding, ongoing feedback and career growth, and provide managers with in-depth insight into their performance.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
  + OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years people management experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years of experience in product management
* Experience leading product managers as a manager, area lead or equivalent with a track record of growing people.
* Proven track record of owning a product line or major product area end to end, from strategy through shipping to measured business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success engaging senior customer stakeholders and executives, and turning those conversations into product direction and resolved blockers.
* Solid cross-group influence: able to align engineering, design, research, marketing, sales, support and finance around a shared plan without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills; data-driven by default.
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated use and adoption of AI in real-life product practices, applying AI agents and tools to research, analysis, specification, prototyping and decision-making, and raising that bar across the team.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: AGM- Product Manager
job_description:
**ABOUT US:**

BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.

Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

-----------------

* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.
* Experience building or launching AI agents or AI-powered product features.
* Familiarity with data privacy and statutory compliance in Indian staffing (e.g. DPDP Act, onboarding documentation).

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering”. You have found the right team.

As “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering Professional / Lead” within our “Asset & Wealth Management – MPX Account Management Services (Account SOR)” , you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

* **Lead** the Operate function for Account Management Services by owning day-to-day product stability, service delivery, and BAU point-of-contact coverage.
* **Partner** with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, and Service Management to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets, incidents, defects, and urgent ad-hoc requests with clear SLAs and communications.
* **Translate** recurring BAU issues and user feedback into product enhancements by defining requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans to improve user/client experience.
* **Establish** operating rhythms and performance metrics (e.g., ticket trends, root-cause themes, time-to-resolution) to drive continuous improvement and proactive risk/controls management.
* **Define** crisp problem statements, use cases, user journeys, success metrics, and acceptance criteria from complex requirements to enable fast, rigorous delivery.
* **Drive** the modernization roadmap across platform evolution, user experience improvements, and scalable operational processes.
* **Identify** AI and Agentic AI opportunities that increase straight-through processing and data quality with safe, explainable, and governable designs.
* **Partner** across Business, Operations, Technology, and Controls to remove blockers, force decisions, and accelerate delivery outcomes.
* **Sequence** work across teams, platforms, and release trains to manage dependencies and deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
* **Stand up** delivery and outcome metrics (quality, timeliness, adoption, STP lift, defect reduction, cycle time) to continuously reshape priorities and the roadmap.
* **Own** the product vision, roadmap, and execution for mission-critical data services powering onboarding, reporting, operational workflows, and investment processes.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Demonstrate** a proven track record as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Lead for data products, platforms, or critical enterprise services (ideally in a major financial institution).
* **Bring** a minimum of 10 years of Financial Services experience blending data, technology, and operations with Asset & Wealth Management data concepts.
* **Deliver** effectively in agile environments with backlog discipline, pragmatic scope control, and outcome-based execution.
* **Work** hands-on with SQL and Python to navigate large datasets, validate hypotheses, investigate issues, and partner credibly with engineering and analytics.
* **Apply** practical fluency with AI and Agentic AI for data products (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection, triage, metadata enrichment, exception handling, workflow orchestration) while evaluating value, risk, scalability, and controls.
* **Influence** stakeholders at every level with sharp written and verbal communication suitable for governance forums and senior leadership.
* **Hold** a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or a related field.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Bring** Asset Management experience with onboarding and servicing.
* **Use** foundational AI/developer tooling such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot within a modern engineering environment.
* **Show** familiarity with data-quality tooling, metadata platforms, lineage frameworks, and modern data platforms (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, distributed processing, APIs, and data services).
* **Earn** product management certifications such as CSPO or PSPO (preferred).
* **Hold** a Master's degree in engineering or computer science and demonstrate a creative mindset for innovative data-solution design.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

job_description:
**SOVOS**

**Associate Product Manager (AI-First)**
========================================

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

**3**

**Meeting with a Recruiter**

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

**Company Background**
----------------------

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

### **Ready to make your move?**

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.

job_description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Chapter Lead

**Your role and responsibilities :**

The candidate will be responsible to start-up and develop new solutions in a specific product range according to the AT/AU strategy. In a global and changing context, effective leadership and market driven thinking are prerequisite for this role.

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the specific product range in the field of Switchgear, you will be accountable for its long-term profitable growth, by developing and managing the product range through its life cycle phases, according to market needs and AT/AU strategy. In a global and evolving market, effective leadership and market driven thinking are prerequisite for this role. Working in a brand-new Agile Organization, you will join the Agile

Team Develop Solutions:

Distribution Boards & Motor Control Centers – part of the Distribution & Energy Management Agile Unit – as a key contributor, understanding the requirements of the industry, specific channels and segments for the product release

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Smart Power Agile in Bangalore or Hyderabad, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

  

* Analyzing market trends, identifying customer needs, and setting market requirements for future development.
* Managing existing solutions used in the market, leveraging in monitoring sales target fulfillment and in taking appropriate actions.
* Defining future features and services.
* Boosting market penetration in line with the AT/AU’s ambitions.

**Qualifications for the role:**

  

* Master’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent work experience also accepted.
* Previous experience in a similar field.
* Understanding of the global and local markets for Enclosure/Switchgear, with experience in product management sales, engineering, R&D, and operational projects.
* Well-developed and well-rounded communication, collaboration, structured, problem-solving, and results-oriented skills.
* Teamwork, a penchant for innovation, attention to customers and stakeholders, and high motivation are essential personal qualities.
* Ability to anticipate customer needs and market trends, driven by curiosity and motivation.

**More about us :**

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are seeking a proactive and client-focused Associate Product Manager to support the delivery and continuous improvement of web and mobile-based sports technology products. The role will act as a bridge between the client and the central Product, Engineering, Design, and QA teams based in Delhi, ensuring that client requirements, feedback, and business priorities are clearly understood and translated into actionable product work.

The candidate will coordinate with client stakeholders, conduct product demonstrations and feature walkthroughs, gather requirements, explain proposed solutions, and track requested changes from discussion through delivery. The role also involves contributing to the definition and development of product modules by preparing workflows, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

The Associate Product Manager will work closely with internal teams to clarify requirements, monitor development progress, manage dependencies, coordinate testing and UAT, and support releases. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and coordination skills with structured product thinking and the ability to take ownership of tasks across the product lifecycle.

**Responsibilities:**

Act as the primary coordination bridge between client stakeholders and the central Product, Engineering, Design, and QA teams in Delhi.

Conduct product demos, feature walkthroughs, and review sessions; explain existing functionality and proposed enhancements clearly to clients.

Gather, analyse, and document client requirements, feedback, change requests, and suggestions; clarify scope, priorities, and expected outcomes.

Translate requirements into product workflows, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and screen- level/module documentation.

Contribute to building and improving product modules by defining user journeys, business rules, edge cases, and expected system behaviour in coordination with design and development teams.

Coordinate with internal teams on sprint planning inputs, task tracking, dependencies, delivery timelines, risks, and follow- ups.

Support product testing, UAT planning and coordination, issue logging, validation of fixes, and sign-off with relevant stakeholders.

Maintain product documentation such as PRDs, requirement documents, meeting notes, decision logs, release notes, and knowledge-transfer materials.

Share regular status updates with clients and internal stakeholders, including progress, open questions, risks, and upcoming milestones,

Support product rollouts, client onboarding, training, feedback collection, and post-release improvement activities.

**Measurable Outcomes / Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Associate Product Manager will be evaluated against the following measurable outcomes, considering agreed project scope, timelines, dependencies, and factors within the role's control.

**Requirement Quality & Clarity:** 100% of requirements and change requests are documented with the business objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcome before handover for development. Requirement Sign-off & Traceability: Maintain documented client decisions and approvals for all the requirements and changes, with traceability from the original request through development, testing, and closure. UAT Coordination & Closure: Coordination of planned UAT cycles and document test scenarios, feedback, defects, and sign-offs. Track all identified issues until closure or a documented decision/acceptance of pending items.

**Delivery Tracking & Follow-up:** Maintain an up-to-date tracker for all the assigned requirements, enhancements, and change requests, including owner, status, target date, dependencies, and risks. Escalate blockers and material timeline deviations promptly.

**Documentation & Product Readiness:** Ensure relevant product documentation (workflows, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, meeting/decision logs, and release notes, as applicable) is prepared for all the assigned features at the relevant development or release milestone.

**Stakeholder Communication:** Provide status updates at the agreed reporting frequency. Circulate meeting minutes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates within one working day of each stakeholder meeting.

**Product Demonstrations & Feedback Management:** Conduct all product demos and feature walkthroughs. Log client feedback and action items, and track each item to resolution, prioritisation, or a documented next step. Change Request Management: Log client change requests and ensure each has a documented assessment of scope and dependencies, status, priority/decision, and next step before implementation commitments are communicated. Cross-functional Coordination: For all assigned tasks requiring cross-functional input, identify owners, dependencies, and follow-up actions; escalate blockers within the agreed project escalation process.

**Module Development & Release Support:** Support assigned modules and enhancements through requirements definition, development coordination, testing, UAT, and release readiness, with deliverables checked against agreed acceptance criteria before closure.

Performance will be reviewed periodically against these KPIs using documented deliverables, agreed project timelines, client feedback, and internal stakeholder reviews. Targets should be assessed in the context of project scope, dependencies, and factors within the role's control.

**Required Skills & Traits**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline.

4-8 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, implementation, client coordination, or a related role; experience in a contractual or client-facing delivery environment is useful.

Good understanding of web and mobile application ecosystems and the product development lifecycle.

Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Zoho Sprints, Trello, or equivalent for backlog and task tracking.

Ability to understand user journeys and translate business needs into clear workflows, requirements, and module-level specifications; exposure to Figma or wireframing.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritisation, and requirement clarification skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in conducting product demos and client discussions.

Ability to coordinate effectively across clients and cross-functional teams, follow up on open items, and manage competing priorities.

High ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and a structured approach to documentation and execution.

Ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, data flows, and system dependencies is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience working with digital products, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, or sports technology products.

Experience preparing PRDs, BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, or other product/business analysis documentation.

Exposure to client demos, requirement workshops, UAT, implementation, onboarding, or change-request management.

Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum practices, sprint cycles, release planning, and software testing.

Interest in sports, fitness, athlete management, event operations, or other sports-tech use cases is desirable.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
Experience: 1–3 years  
Location: Bengaluru (Work from Office – Domlur)

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who is proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited about building AI-first products.

You should be someone who takes ownership, figures things out independently, and enjoys solving problems. We value people who can move fast, experiment, and get things done without needing constant direction.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own product initiatives end-to-end, from identifying problems to launching solutions and measuring impact.
* Work on AI-first products, identifying opportunities to use GenAI and automation to improve user experience and business outcomes.
* Conduct customer research, understand user pain points, and translate insights into product improvements.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Business teams to build and ship products.
* Define and track product metrics, analyze funnels, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build quick prototypes, test ideas, and iterate based on feedback and data.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Engineering or a technical discipline.
* Experience: 1–3 years in Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, or related roles.
* High agency: Someone who takes initiative, works independently, and finds ways to get things done.
* AI-first mindset: Actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and is curious about building products using AI.
* Problem-solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to break down ambiguous problems.
* Product sense: Good understanding of user experience and what makes a product work well.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and work with different teams.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience building AI agents, prototypes, or side projects using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Replit.
* Experience with consumer products, growth, or monetisation.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, SEO, or digital marketing.
* Previous startup or 01 product experience.

We are particularly interested in people who have built something on their own, whether it's a side project, a small product, or an AI-powered tool. We care about what you've done, not just the roles you've held.
